title: Text transformation
description: Changes the text merged from another regional client into this client's sheets. "name" and "description" with a string value describe the file; each other key not starting with _ is a regular expression matched against sheet names (ECMAScript, case-insensitive, matching anywhere in the name; e.g. "^Item$", "^quest/", or "" for every sheet). Every matching entry applies, in file order.

oneOf.description: Name shown in XivAlexander's settings instead of the file name.
What the file does, shown in XivAlexander's settings.

sheetRule.description: What to do with the sheets whose names match the key. A sheet's string columns, sorted by their offset in this client's sheet, are numbered 0, 1, 2...

*.description: Steps for every string column of the sheet.

keep.description: Cells kept in the client's language; steps do not change them.

unkeep.description: Undoes "keep", including cells kept automatically (such as quest phrases typed in /say).

^[0-9]{1,5}$.description: A string column of this client's sheet.

oneOf.description: Keeps the client's own language in this column.
Takes this column from that string column of the other client's sheet, instead of the one found by offset.

steps.description: Steps run in order on "<merged text>\u001F<client text>", with the merged text empty where it is the same as the client's; afterwards, the cell is the text before the first \u001F if one is left, otherwise all of it. Line breaks are \n; other macros are single placeholder characters that must stay whole: keep or drop all of one side's macros, and never repeat one. Step lists of every matching entry add up per column, in file order.

oneOf.description: [pattern, replacement]: replaces every match of the pattern (ECMAScript regular expression, per Unicode character; \n and \uXXXX escapes work in both; $1, $& in the replacement).
Normalizes the text to Unicode NFD or NFC.

items.description: One cell, by row id or by the text key in string column 0. Without "column", the cell is in string column 1 if string column 0 holds text keys (only A-Z, 0-9, _; quest and dialogue sheets), otherwise in string column 0.
